#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Targeted actual capture-core callback gate; Android callbacks are explicit host doubles."""
import argparse,hashlib,json,os,signal,stat,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
def need(ok,msg):
    if not ok: raise RuntimeError(msg)
def sha(raw):return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def exact(path):
    s=path.lstat();need(stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_nlink==1 and not path.is_symlink(),"regular independent test input")
    raw=path.read_bytes();t=path.lstat()
    need((s.st_dev,s.st_ino,s.st_size,s.st_mtime_ns,s.st_ctime_ns)==(t.st_dev,t.st_ino,t.st_size,t.st_mtime_ns,t.st_ctime_ns) and len(raw)==s.st_size,"test input changed")
    return raw
def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    for key in ("source-root","fixtures","out","java-home","json-jar","expected-json-jar-sha256"):parser.add_argument("--"+key,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args();source=Path(args.source_root);fixtures=Path(args.fixtures);out=Path(args.out);jdk=Path(args.java_home);jar=Path(args.json_jar)
    need(sha(exact(jar))==args.expected_json_jar_sha256,"exact host JSON jar")
    inputs=[source/"src/org/trillionnium/hepta/webhelper"/(name+".java") for name in ("CaptureReadBudget","DomInstabilityEvidence","OfficialPageCapture")]
    inputs+=[source/"src/org/trillionnium/hepta/webprotocol/WebEvidenceProtocol.java"]
    inputs+=sorted((fixtures/"stubs").rglob("*.java"))
    inputs+=[fixtures/"CaptureRetryHostTest.java"]
    need(len(inputs)==24 and len(set(inputs))==24,"actual production core plus 19 explicit Android/site doubles and one test")
    before={str(p):exact(p) for p in inputs}
    asset=source/"assets/readonly_dom.js";asset_raw=exact(asset)
    need(sha(asset_raw)=="0d1b412d2e81e3f447ef36977bb27c321c136c207d64cca433a810f22ca5c983","actual fixed DOM observer asset unchanged")
    # Independent nested result root; no pre-existing output can be overwritten.
    out.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    result={"schema":"hepta.capture-retry-host-gate.v1","all_pass":False,"exit_code":1,"steps":[],
        "source_inputs":[{"path":p,"bytes":len(b),"sha256":sha(b)} for p,b in before.items()],
        "android_callbacks":"deterministic host doubles","javascript_executed":False,"phone_tested":False,
        "actual_mi_dom_seen":False,"business_verified":False,"old_unrelated_contracts_rerun":False}
    def run(name,argv,timeout):
        stdout=out/(name+".stdout");stderr=out/(name+".stderr");started=time.monotonic();forced=False
        with stdout.open("xb") as o,stderr.open("xb") as e:
            child=subprocess.Popen([str(x) for x in argv],cwd=out,stdout=o,stderr=e,start_new_session=True)
            try:code=child.wait(timeout=timeout)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                forced=True
                try:os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
                except ProcessLookupError:pass
                code=child.wait(timeout=10)
        a=exact(stdout);b=exact(stderr)
        need(len(a)<=2000000 and len(b)<=2000000,"bounded test logs")
        result["steps"].append({"name":name,"argv":[str(x) for x in argv],"exit_code":code,"forced":forced,
            "elapsed_seconds":time.monotonic()-started,"stdout":{"path":str(stdout),"bytes":len(a),"sha256":sha(a)},
            "stderr":{"path":str(stderr),"bytes":len(b),"sha256":sha(b)}})
        need(code==0 and not forced,"actual targeted host stage failed: "+name)
    try:
        classes=out/"classes";classes.mkdir()
        run("javac",[jdk/"bin/javac","--release","8","-encoding","UTF-8","-proc:none","-cp",jar,"-d",classes,*inputs],90)
        run("callback-tests",[jdk/"bin/java","-cp",str(classes)+os.pathsep+str(jar),
            "org.trillionnium.hepta.webhelper.CaptureRetryHostTest",asset,out/"TEST-RESULT.json"],90)
        raw=exact(out/"TEST-RESULT.json");test=json.loads(raw)
        need(test["all_pass"] is True and test["cases"]==33 and len(test["case_names"])==33
            and len(set(test["case_names"]))==33 and test["actual_production_capture_classes"] is True
            and test["phone_tested"] is False and test["javascript_executed"] is False
            and test["business_verified"] is False and test["actual_mi_dom_seen"] is False,"actual bounded callback cases")
        result.update(test_result={"path":str(out/"TEST-RESULT.json"),"bytes":len(raw),"sha256":sha(raw)},
            capture_retry_checks=test["cases"],capture_retry_assertions=test["assertions"])
        need(all(exact(Path(p))==b for p,b in before.items()) and exact(asset)==asset_raw,"production/test/asset inputs changed")
        result.update(all_pass=True,exit_code=0,source_unchanged=True)
    except Exception as error:result["error"]=type(error).__name__+": "+str(error)
    raw=(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+"\n").encode()
    with (out/"RESULT.json").open("xb") as f:f.write(raw);f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
    need(exact(out/"RESULT.json")==raw,"gate result readback")
    print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(",",":")),flush=True)
    return result["exit_code"]
if __name__=="__main__":raise SystemExit(main())
